outcome: The work item page renders a line workspace from the data alone and takes a step safely (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: **Unchanged without a workspace.** W-2010 (and W-1701, W-1901) render exactly as before. — verify: `tests/work-item.test.tsx`, `work-item-board.test.tsx`, `decide.test.tsx`, `response.test.tsx` pass unchanged; a new test asserts no workspace element on W-2010.

**Header from data.** On W-2001 the page shows the returned `subtitle`, status tag word, `byline`, `version.label`, crumbs and `agent_note` lines; each absent field on W-2005 draws nothing. There is exactly one `h1` (the work item title); `workspace.title` is an `h2` only when different. — verify: component test on W-2001 and W-2005; e2e counts `h1`.

**Nine section kinds.** W-2001 to W-2004 draw each of facts, table, checklist, findings, suggestions, recipients, figures, text, timeline with the elements in the Contract table, in returned order. Table cells render by column kind; a cell `link` becomes an anchor only for an app path. — verify: `tests/workspace.test.tsx`, one test per kind; `<a>` count for a crafted `link` of `https://x.example` is zero.

**Item vocab as words.** Every item `status`, `receipt` and `severity` value on W-2003 and W-2001 appears as a word in text (not colour alone); `receipt: uncertain` never reads "Received". An unknown enum value renders raw. — verify: component tests; axe in criterion 11.

**INV-UNKNOWN.** On W-2004 an unknown amount, `due.unknown`, and an unknown date read "Unknown"; the page contains no "0", "₦0", "-" or empty cell in their place. — verify: component test over the DOM text of those cells.

**INV-RESTRICTED.** On W-2004 a `restricted` section shows only `restricted_label` and no row text, no `cites`, no `money`, even though the fixture also carries data for those rows (the fixture includes it deliberately, to prove it is not drawn). A restricted cell reads "Restricted". — verify: component test that none of the fixture's hidden strings appears in `document.body.textContent`.
**as_of, coverage, sample.** As_of (WAT), `coverage` text and the sample label show on W-2004; absent elsewhere. — verify: component test.
**Empty.** W-2005 shows "Nothing here yet." for an empty section and nothing else for a workspace with no sections or steps; no exception is thrown. — verify: component test.

**Paging and filters inert.** W-2002 shows filters, total and "Show more" disabled with "More rows aren’t available yet."; activating them sends no request. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch` (only the GET E-WORK-ITEM calls).

**Fixtures valid, old untouched.** Every `W-20xx` fixture validates against the generated schema; `git diff --stat` shows no edit to any existing fixture. — verify: `tests/mock-contract.test.ts`; `git diff --stat`.

**Accessibility and layout (Part A).** For W-2001 to W-2005 at 1440 and 390: no axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`), no sideways scroll (`scrollWidth <= viewport`), visible focus rings, 44px targets, tables scroll inside their own container at 390, no animation under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`. — verify: `e2e/workspace.spec.ts`.

**Steps only as returned.** Controls appear only for steps in `workspace.steps`; none when `workspace.revision` is absent; none are derived from `/me` (a persona with any role sees the same controls for the same fixture). `disabled_reason` shows as text, the control is `aria-disabled`, and activating it sends nothing. — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`.

**Scopes.** `workspace` steps in the row; `item` steps on the right items only (`steps[]` contains the key); an `items` step is disabled with zero checked, and sends `item_ids` = the checked ids in item order. — verify: component test reading the recorded body (W-2002).

**Form from descriptors.** On W-2006 every field kind renders through `IntakeField`, `display` is shown and never sent, `required`, `help`, `depends_on` behave as in Start work, and only descriptor checks run client-side. A step with `confirm` shows its text above the submit. `restricted` field draws no value. — verify: component test; `git diff --stat` shows no behavioural edit in `features/start-work/**`.

**Write request shape.** Submitting a W-2006 step sends exactly one POST `/api/v1/work/W-2006/steps` with the CSRF header, `expected_revision` equal to `workspace.revision`, `step`, `inputs` shaped per kind, `idempotency_key` (a UUID), `evidence_ids` only if an evidence field was filled, `note` only if a `note` field exists and is non-blank; a `note` over 2000 characters is refused before any request. The body validates against the generated request schema. — verify: `tests/workspace-step.test.tsx` and `workspace-mock.test.ts`.

**One key per attempt; no double send.** A double click sends one request; while pending the button is disabled and reads "<label>…". Opening the form twice gives two different keys; a manual "Try again" after a network failure on a non-`sends` step reuses the first key; a key is renewed after `done`, 409 and 422. Under React StrictMode no request is sent twice. — verify: component tests; e2e reads `GET /__mock/workspace-log` (the mock's send count for that key is 1). This is mock evidence only, not proof of backend idempotency.

**No automatic retry.** For 500, network failure, 409 and `effect_uncertain` the count of POSTs to the steps URL stays 1 until the person presses again, after waiting beyond any plausible timer (fake timers advanced by 60s). — verify: component tests.
**done and queued.** `done` reloads once and shows the live "Done" line with the new revision; `queued` shows "Waiting: …" and reloads once; neither resends. — verify: tests on W-2001 and W-2007.

**effect_uncertain (INV-RESEND).** On W-2008 `effect_uncertain` shows the uncertain callout with the returned `message`; every step control on the page is off; after the reload `ReconcilePanel` is shown and its answer goes to E-WORK-ACTION (one POST to `/actions`, none to `/steps`); no new key or resend is possible. When the reloaded item has no `reconcile`, the page says "We are checking what happened. Nothing was sent again." and offers a reload only. — verify: component test and e2e with the recorded requests.

**409.** On W-2007 a 409 keeps the typed inputs, reloads once, shows "This changed while you were working. Showing version 5.", re-bases `expected_revision` to 5, and sends nothing until the next deliberate press, with a new key. — verify: component test and e2e.

**422.** On W-2006 a 422 with `fields[]` puts each message under its input (`aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`), focuses the first, keeps all inputs, shows an unnamed message at the top, and renews the key. — verify: component test.

**Other errors.** 401 shows the signed-out callout with `next` = this page. 403 reloads and shows "You can’t take that step.". 404 shows `NoAccessState` with no id or title. A 500 on a `sends` step offers no resubmit; on a non-`sends` step a manual Try again with the same key. — verify: component tests.

**Decision steps.** The `task_id` step on W-2009 is a link to `/work/W-2009/decide?task=T-2009`; following it opens the F-16 page; the workspace itself sends no request to `/steps`, `/claim` or `/decision`. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`; e2e navigates and sees the decision page.

**Part B accessibility.** For W-2006 to W-2009 at 1440 and 390: axe clean, no sideways scroll, focus moves to the form heading on open and back to the step control on close or Escape, errors are announced (`role="alert"` or an associated live region), live regions for done, waiting and uncertain, 44px targets, reduced motion respected. — verify: `e2e/workspace.spec.ts`.

**Region-level design check.** After the design engineer signs Conflicts 1: every region in `regions.json` passes at 1440 and 390 with structure and text coverage 100% after exceptions and visual >= 85, via `region-check.mjs`. `fidelity-exceptions.json` entries each carry `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason`, `approved_by` (`"builder proposal, pending design engineer"` until confirmed), and none covers a value the data can supply. — verify: `round-<N>/fidelity/region-scores.txt` and per-region reports; build.md maps exceptions to categories.
**Tokens only.** `grep -nE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(|hsl\(" frontend/src/features/workspace/*.css` returns nothing. — verify: the command.

**Contract is not extended.** `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**`, `apps/**`, `architecture/**` or `design/**`; every field the renderer wanted but the schema lacks is listed in build.md as a contract proposal. — verify: `git diff --stat` and build.md.

**No real send, no overclaim.** Every request in the e2e run goes to the mock (4702); the PR description and build.md state D-LINE-WORKSPACE limits and do not claim idempotency or a real backend. — verify: build.md content and the recorded requests.

**Existing tests not weakened.** `tests/work-item*.test.tsx`, `decide*.test.tsx`, `response*.test.tsx`, `start-work*.test.*`, `shell.test.tsx`, `e2e/work-item*.spec.ts`, `e2e/decide*.spec.ts`, `e2e/response.spec.ts`, `e2e/start-work.spec.ts` pass; no assertion removed or loosened. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`; `git diff` on those test files shows none.

**New tests exist and run in checks.** `workspace.test.tsx`, `workspace-step.test.tsx`, `workspace-mock.test.ts` and `e2e/workspace.spec.ts` exist and run in `delivery/checks.sh`. — verify: file presence and the run output in build.md.

risk.rationale: Medium. The frame is a shared renderer on `features/work-item/**` (also touched by F-09, F-14, F-16) and defines the one write that every later line uses, including steps that send to clients (`sends`, `effect_uncertain`, INV-RESEND), so a wrong duplicate-submit, retry or restricted-section rule here is copied into about 25 screens. It stays at medium and not high because it is mock-only, the write is unimplemented in the backend, and nothing is released. SURFACES: `ui` (the renderer), `api` (new write and request shape), `contract-change` (it consumes a still-proposed v7 block that the backend developer may change) and `external-messaging` (steps that send and uncertain-effect handling). Money appears only as displayed values (unknown never 0); payment decisions are out of scope, so `payments` is not listed.

findings.summary: **Phone reconcile is unreachable behind the Decide bar.** Steps: persona finance_lead, viewport 390x844 (also 320x640), `/work/W-2008`, press "Approve and send". The mock returns `effect_uncertain`, the item is read again, and ReconcilePanel mounts. Expected: the person can choose "It didn't arrive" and tap "Record and continue" (spec criterion 19; INV-RESEND recovery). Actual: two fixed bottom bars are stacked. F-09's `.resp-actionbar` (`frontend/src/features/response/response.css:146`, z-index 5) is at y 762-844, and F-17's `.ws-decide` (`frontend/src/features/workspace/workspace.css:153`, z-index 5, later in the DOM) is at y 722-844 on top of it. The Decide bar holds only aria-disabled steps and "Confirm what happened first." At maximum scroll (565 at 390) "Record and continue" is still at 776-826, inside the Decide bar's area. Playwright's click fails with "`<div class="ws-steps__buttons">` intercepts pointer events". Focusing it and pressing Enter does send the one POST to `/actions`, so the keyboard path works and the touch path does not. The class depends on `allLocked`, which is client state set only after an uncertain step in this session. If a page loads fresh with the server already showing a reconcile panel and Decide steps still present, the Decide bar stays fixed and could cover the reconcile button again. The test only covers the in-session path. Check whether the server omits workspace steps in that state. If it does, there is nothing to fix. If not, key the class on `hasReconcile` alone.

**A reload re-enables a resend while delivery is uncertain.** Steps: persona finance_lead, any viewport (I checked 1440 and 390), `/work/W-2008`, press "Approve and send" (the mock replies `effect_uncertain` and the reconcile panel shows), reload the page, then press "Approve and send" again. Expected (spec criterion 19, outcome table row `effect_uncertain`, INV-RESEND): every step stays off while the item is waiting for reconcile, with no new key and no resend. Actual: after the reload, both Decide buttons have no `aria-disabled` and are enabled. The press sends a second `POST /api/v1/work/W-2008/steps` with a new key. Mock log: `[["approve_send",200,key aa6148cf,rev 3],["approve_send",200,key 1946d824,rev 4]]`. The page shows "Delivery uncertain" and "Confirm what happened before anything is resent." alongside the live send button. Cause: as in QA-5-1, `off()` (`Workspace.tsx:111`) reads `flow.allLocked`, which a reload clears. Expected fix: treat `hasReconcile` (item has `reconcile` and `allowed_actions` includes `reconcile`) as all-locked, with the "Confirm what happened first." hint. The backend must still refuse it (not provable on the mock).
